# awscc_devopsagent_trigger (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::DevOpsAgent::Trigger



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `action` (String) The action to perform when the trigger fires. A JSON object containing actionType and task.
- `agent_space_id` (String) The unique identifier of the parent Agent Space.
- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the trigger. Nested under the parent Agent Space: arn:<partition>:aidevops:<region>:<account-id>:agentspace/<agentspace-id>/trigger/<trigger-id>.
- `condition` (Attributes) The condition that causes the trigger to fire. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--condition))
- `created_at` (String) The timestamp when the trigger was created.
- `status` (String) The status of the trigger. Active triggers fire on schedule; Inactive triggers are paused.
- `trigger_id` (String) The unique identifier of the trigger (assigned by the service on Create).
- `type` (String) The type of trigger.
- `updated_at` (String) The timestamp when the trigger was last updated.

<a id="nestedatt--condition"></a>
### Nested Schema for `condition`

Read-Only:

- `schedule` (Attributes) Schedule configuration for a time-based trigger. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--condition--schedule))

<a id="nestedatt--condition--schedule"></a>
### Nested Schema for `condition.schedule`

Read-Only:

- `expression` (String) A cron or rate expression that defines when the trigger fires.
